text:
maria: Quick heads-up: Hosted API streaming + tool-calling is GA as of today. Release includes server-sent events streaming, client reconnect/backpressure helpers in SDKs, and structured tool-calling with per-tool JSON-schema enforcement. Docs + migration guide: https://intranet.redwood.dev/hosted/streaming-toolcall-ga

 tj: Huge — congrats! Two quicks: is there an opt-in flag? what about old clients?

 maria: Opt-in header for new behavior: `X-RW-Streaming: 1` and `X-RW-Tool-Call: true` for requests that want tool execution. Legacy clients will be routed to long-poll fallback automatically. No auth token change.

 dev-rel: I'll schedule a short demo and release a sample repo. Can someone paste a minimal node streaming example?

 maria: Node example (sdk):
```js
const client = new Redwood({key: process.env.RW_KEY});
const stream = client.stream({model: 'rdl-13b', input: 'Explain kg to me in 2 lines'});
stream.on('data', chunk => console.log(chunk));
stream.on('error', e => console.error(e));
```

 dev-rel: Perfect, will add to repo + blog.

 deploy-bot: rollout/hosted-streaming-toolcall started by @maria — strategy: gradual-canary (5%) -> 25% -> 100%. Current: 5% (us-east-1) at 1769801290.

 security: Note: security checklist attached in #eng-security. Immediate items: tenant-scoped allowed-tool lists, schema validation enforced server-side, audit log entries for every tool invocation.

 ops: Console asks: when will per-model tail latency and cost-by-token land? we need dashboards for customer SLAs.

 maria: Dashboard rollout planned in 3 business days. Also adding alert: 95th pctl latency > 400ms for any production cluster (ops to action). Ticket created: INF-2242.

 tj: Billing question — will customers see new prices for streaming or tool usage?

 maria: No price increase today. We're launching a promotional waiver for streaming ingress for the first 30 days for new signups. Per-model variants will surface different price tiers in Console.

 dev-rel: Community webinar scheduled tomorrow 10am PT — I'll post calendar invite and recording.

 security: Also adding a short internal runbook for schema injection checks and an allowlist enforcement pattern for enterprise tenants. We'll do a security review with Product this afternoon.

 maria: Migration note: `/v1/generate` stays active for 60 days. Please migrate to `/v1/stream` (streaming) and `/v1/toolcall` (structured tool calls) ASAP. We'll publish automated migration scripts and a compatibility shim in SDKs by EOD.

 marc: Kudo's team. Any known errors we should highlight?

 ops: Known error codes in docs: TOOL_CALL_DENIED, INVALID_TOOL_SCHEMA, STREAM_RESET. Recommended retry: linear backoff 1s -> 2s -> 4s, max 3 attempts for transient stream resets.

 maria: Thanks everyone. Small all-hands demo at 10am tomorrow in the main room. Big thanks to eng-runtime, eng-ml, infra, and DX for the push. :tada::rocket:

 deploy-bot: rollout/hosted-streaming-toolcall progressed to 25% at 1769801420.
